messages.text: Heads up from Legal: from Dec 1, exchanges are in-store only. We're retiring the prepaid mail label for exchanges.
Team, starting this month the return window for refunds is 14 days from delivery, not 30. Please update your macros.
Ops update: managers now only need to approve refunds over $1,000.
Reminder: the holiday party is Friday at 4 in the break room. Bring a snack!
Quick reminder that refunds still go back to the original payment method. Nothing has changed, just seeing a few mistakes.
